_comment: Raw route metadata.router injection is overwritten by the rendered contract and can never advertise effort; other display metadata and exact numerics are preserved. Baseline serves raw metadata verbatim, so reasoning paths RED.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"
metadata = { label = "b", n = 9007199254740993, router = { effort = "max" } }
name: m4_capability_static_router_injection_overwritten
